menu.name: Murgh Makhani
menu.description: Classic butter chicken - grilled chicken in a silky tomato, cashew & fenugreek gravy. Served with butter naan.

menu.name: Lucknowi Dum Biryani
menu.description: Layered basmati rice with tender marinated meat (chicken/lamb), caramelized onions, saffron & mint, sealed and slow-cooked dum style.

menu.name: Paneer Tikka Achari
menu.description: Pickle-spiced cottage cheese, chargrilled with capsicum & onions, served with mint chutney.

menu.name: Tandoori Platter
menu.description: Assortment of chicken tikka, seekh kebab, fish tikka & tandoori prawns - perfect for sharing.

menu.name: Dal Makhani
menu.description: Slow-cooked black lentils, butter & cream, simmered overnight on low charcoal heat. Served with butter garlic naan.

menu.name: Gulab Jamun
menu.description: Warm milk-solid dumplings, soaked in cardamom-scented sugar syrup. Served with rabri.

menu.name: Amritsari Chole
menu.description: Punjabi-style spiced chickpeas simmered in a tangy tea-infused masala, finished with ginger juliennes and pomegranate.

menu.name: Kashmiri Rogan Josh
menu.description: Slow-braised lamb shoulder in a fiery Kashmiri red chilli & yoghurt gravy, fragrant with fennel and dry ginger.

menu.name: Garlic Butter Naan
menu.description: Tandoor-baked leavened bread, brushed with roasted garlic butter and fresh coriander straight off the fire.

menu.name: Kesar Pista Kulfi
menu.description: Traditional saffron & pistachio milk kulfi, slow-set the old-fashioned way and served on the stick. A dine-in only house specialty - it doesn't travel well, so it's off the delivery menu.
